insight: The first mainstream AI pair programmer, launched in June 2021 powered by OpenAI's Codex model.
name: GitHub Copilot
tagline: AI pair programmer in your editor — completions, chat, and agents.
description: The original in-editor AI coding assistant, offering multi-line completions, chat with codebase context, agent mode, and a cloud coding agent that opens pull requests. Runs across VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, the CLI, and GitHub.com. A free tier covers light use; paid tiers add premium models and more allowance.

modelSupport.notes: Model picker spans Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google across chat and agents.

edge: Deepest IDE + GitHub-native reach — runs in VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, CLI, and ships a cloud agent that opens PRs.
